job.job_description:
Job Title: AI Engineer / NLP, LLM & Agentic AI Specialist (Python)

Location: Chennai

Experience Level: Mid-Level / Senior

Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary

We are looking for a passionate AI Engineer with strong expertise in Python, Natural Language Processing (NLP), Large Language Models (LLMs), and emerging Agentic AI systems. You will design and build intelligent, autonomous language-based solutions, integrate LLM APIs, and develop AI agents capable of reasoning, planning, and executing multi-step tasks in real-world applications.

Key Responsibilities

Model Development, NLP & Agentic Systems

Design and build NLP pipelines for tasks like classification, NER, summarization, sentiment analysis, and Q&A.
Fine-tune and optimize open-source LLMs (e.g., BERT, GPT, T5) using Hugging Face Transformers.
Develop agentic AI workflows that enable autonomous decision-making, multi-step reasoning, and tool usage.
Build and orchestrate AI agents capable of interacting with APIs, databases, and external tools.
Preprocess and structure large-scale textual datasets using SpaCy, NLTK, or custom tokenizers.

LLM Integration, Prompt Engineering & Agents

Integrate LLM APIs (OpenAI, Claude, Cohere, Hugging Face) into real-time applications.
Design, develop, and optimize prompt strategies and agent behaviors for reliability and performance.
Build intelligent agents for use cases like chatbots, copilots, recommendation systems, and automation workflows.
Implement tool-augmented agents and function-calling pipelines.
Collaborate with product teams to embed LLMs and agentic systems into user-facing applications.

Deployment & Continuous Improvement

Deploy models and agent systems as APIs using Flask, FastAPI, or Streamlit; containerize with Docker.
Monitor model and agent performance, including reasoning accuracy and task completion rates.
Implement evaluation pipelines for LLM and agent outputs.
Continuously improve systems using user feedback and performance metrics.
Stay updated with advancements in GenAI, agent frameworks, and NLP research.

Required Skills & Experience

Proficient in Python and NLP libraries (SpaCy, Transformers, NLTK, Gensim).
Hands-on experience with LLM APIs and prompt-driven application development.
Strong understanding of agentic AI concepts (planning, memory, tool use, multi-step reasoning).
Experience with Hugging Face Transformers for training/fine-tuning.
Knowledge of NLP fundamentals: embeddings, attention, tokenization.
Familiarity with vector databases like FAISS, Weaviate, or Pinecone (RAG systems).
Experience building REST APIs and working with Docker and Git.

Preferred / Bonus Skills

Experience with agent frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar tools.
Knowledge of RAG pipelines and agent-based retrieval workflows.
Familiarity with evaluation metrics like BLEU, ROUGE, perplexity, cosine similarity.
Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure).
Experience in LLMOps, observability, and agent monitoring tools (PromptLayer, LangSmith, etc.).
Contributions to NLP/GenAI open-source projects or research.
